name: Grupo Gicsa S.A.B. de C.V.
summary: Grupo Gicsa S.A.B. de C.V. engages in real estate and residential property development activities in Mexico. The company involves development, investment, acquisition, construction, leasing, marketing, and sale of shopping centers, corporate offices, entertainment, hotels, and mixed-use properties. The company also engages in real estate property administration, operation, and maintenance activities; and brokerage and stock holding services. Grupo Gicsa S.A.B. de C.V. was founded in 1989 and is based in Mexico City, Mexico.
